// a single-line comment /* a multiline comment */ package com.example.app; import java.util.List; import java.util.*; @Deprecated public class Widget extends Base implements Runnable { private static final int MAX_SIZE = 10; protected volatile boolean running = false; char initial = 'x'; char escaped = '\n'; String name = "a \"quoted\" value"; double ratio = 1_000.5e3d; float small = 0.5f; int hex = 0xFF_FF; int bin = 0b1010_1010; int oct = 0777; long big = 1_234L; var inferred = List.of(1, 2); public static void main(String[] args) { Widget w = new Widget(); outer: for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) { if (i % 2 == 0) continue outer; switch (i) { case 1: break; default: throw new IllegalStateException("bad"); } } try { w.run(); } catch (Exception e) { assert e != null; } finally { w.close(); } } @Override public void run() { String text = """ a text block with "quotes" inside """; System.out.println(text); } private synchronized void close() throws Exception { this.running = false; } } interface Shape { double area(); } record Point(int x, int y) {} enum Colour { RED, GREEN, BLUE }
